introHtml: Running events demand quick, mess-free hydration for participants. Custom running disposable cups are designed for easy grab-and-go use at aid stations, with lightweight construction and printed branding that stands out. Whether you're organizing a 5K or a marathon, these cups offer a practical way to keep runners hydrated while promoting your event or sponsor. Choose from paper or plastic options, and add your logo or race details with full-color printing.
